sourcePolicy: Rules are derived from user-supplied editorial references but reviewed independently before activation.

deterministicRules.description: Normalize the legacy glyph 説 to Taiwan-standard 說.
Normalize six ASCII periods to the Chinese ellipsis.

reviewOnlyFamilies.description: 的／地／得 depends on syntax and must not be replaced globally.
做／作 depends on lexical context and must not be replaced globally.
Buddhist homophones require source or audio grounding.
Repeated speech is preserved unless audio and editorial policy prove it is removable filler.
